positions.name: MigrationDecisionParameters
positions.frame: how is a database migration decision recorded through its load-bearing parameters?
positions.why: Three parallel-structured summary entries by the same actor distill the migration decision into its key parameters: the migration target, the performance gain, and the timeline. All three share colon-header formatting and record the decision as settled, though the performance claim (src-3) sits at claim-level conviction while the migration and timeline (src-2, src-4) sit at decision-level — the frame holds both the ratified commitment and its supporting rationale without resolving the gradient.
